exam.title: بنك الأسئلة الشامل للغة الإنجليزية - الجامعة الافتراضية (الجزء العاشر)
exam.description: الأسئلة من 851 إلى 1000 - مستخرجة من ملف Full set.pdf مع شرح مفصل لكل إجابة

questions.question: The tennis player Boris Becker ______ 17 years old when he first won Wimbledon.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الفعل في الماضي البسيط لأن الحدث وقع في الماضي ('when he first won'). الفاعل 'Boris Becker' مفرد، لذا نستخدم 'was'. 'is' للحاضر، و'are' و'were' للجمع.

questions.question: Bats can fly, ______ they can't swim.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'but' تستخدم للربط بين جملتين متضادتين. الخفافيش تستطيع الطيران ولكنها لا تستطيع السباحة. 'and' للجمع، و'then' للترتيب الزمني، و'or' للاختيار.

questions.question: The teacher always ______ English at class.
questions.explanation: 🔍 مع الفاعل المفرد 'The teacher' في المضارع البسيط نضيف 's' للفعل. 'always' تدل على عادة. 'speaking' و'to speak' لا تصلحان كفعل رئيسي.

questions.question: He ______ a book when I came home.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي المستمر (was reading) يستخدم لفعل كان مستمراً عند حدوث فعل آخر (came). 'read' للماضي البسيط، و'will read' للمستقبل، و'reads' للمضارع.

questions.question: Tom is ______ Beth.
questions.explanation: 🔍 للمقارنة بين شخصين نستخدم 'taller than'. 'tall' للمفرد، و'the tallest' للتفضيل بين ثلاثة فأكثر، و'more tall' خطأ (الصحيح 'taller').

questions.question: Her birthday is ______ June 11.
questions.explanation: 🔍 نستخدم 'on' مع التواريخ المحددة (June 11). 'in' مع الشهور والسنوات، و'at' مع الساعات، و'during' مع الفترات.

questions.question: Where did he ______?
questions.explanation: 🔍 بعد 'did' في السؤال نستخدم المصدر (V1). 'go' هو المصدر الصحيح. 'went' ماضي، و'goes' مضارع مفرد، و'gone' تصريف ثالث.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Can he plays tennis?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'plays' هو الخطأ. بعد 'can' نستخدم المصدر (V1). الصحيح: 'Can he play tennis?'

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: You won't find Jerry at home right now. He studies in the library.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'studies' هو الخطأ. الجملة تتحدث عن حدث يحدث الآن ('right now')، لذا يجب استخدام المضارع المستمر: 'is studying'. 'studies' للمضارع البسيط (عادة).

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: How does you go to work?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'does' هو الخطأ. مع الفاعل 'you' نستخدم 'do' وليس 'does'. الصحيح: 'How do you go to work?'

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT order only.
options: The fruit in September is harvested.
The fruit is harvested in September.
The fruit harvested in September is.
Is harvested in September the fruit.
questions.explanation: 🔍 ترتيب الجملة الصحيح: فاعل + فعل + مفعول به + ظرف زمان. 'The fruit is harvested in September.' الخيارات الأخرى بها أخطاء في الترتيب.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT order only.
questions.explanation: 🔍 ترتيب السؤال الصحيح: أداة السؤال + فعل مساعد + فاعل + فعل رئيسي. 'Where are they sitting?' الخيارات الأخرى بها أخطاء في الترتيب.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT structure: You must be kidding.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الصيغة الصحيحة: فاعل + must + be + V-ing. 'You must be kidding' = لا بد أنك تمزح. الخيارات الأخرى بها أخطاء في ترتيب الكلمات.

questions.question: She ______ Biology when she was abroad.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الفعل في الماضي البسيط لأن الحدث وقع في الماضي وانتهى ('when she was abroad'). 'studied' هو الصحيح. 'has studied' للمضارع التام.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Your school has got a very clean rooms.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'a' هو الخطأ. 'rooms' جمع، لذا لا نستخدم 'a' معه. الصحيح: 'Your school has got very clean rooms.'

questions.question: He ______ about birds. It drives me mad!
questions.explanation: 🔍 'is always talking' = المضارع المستمر مع 'always' للتعبير عن عادة مزعجة ومتكررة. 'He is always talking about birds' = يتحدث دائماً عن الطيور (ويضايقني).

questions.question: Hello Mary? It's me. Listen, I ______ up your road. I'll be with you in five minutes!
questions.explanation: 🔍 المضارع المستمر (am just walking) يستخدم للحدث الجاري الآن. المتحدث يقول إنه يمشي في الطريق الآن وسيصل بعد خمس دقائق.

questions.question: This shirt fits me perfectly. I ______ it.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'am going to take' للقرارات والخطط المستقبلية. المتحدث قرر شراء القميص. 'will take' تستخدم للقرارات الفورية.

questions.question: I traveled to Egypt ______ the pyramids.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'to + V1' تستخدم للتعبير عن الغرض. 'I traveled to Egypt to see the pyramids' = سافرت إلى مصر لرؤية الأهرامات. 'to seeing' و'to have seen' خطأ.

questions.question: After her parents' death, she had to look ______ her younger brothers.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Look after' = يعتني بـ. 'look after her brothers' = تعتني بإخوتها. 'look on' و'look at' و'look before' لا تعبر عن الاعتناء.

questions.question: Nathan ______ three books so far.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'so far' = حتى الآن، وتستخدم مع المضارع التام. 'has written' = كتب (وما زال يكتب). 'has been writing' تؤكد على الاستمرارية.

questions.question: Do you think ______ would lend ______ some money?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'he' هو الفاعل في جملة 'would lend'، و'me' هو المفعول به. 'him' لا يصلح كفاعل، و'I' لا يصلح كمفعول به.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: I would like to speaking to her for three minutes if she can.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'speaking' هو الخطأ. بعد 'would like to' نستخدم المصدر (V1). الصحيح: 'I would like to speak to her...'

questions.question: She would help you if you ______ ask her to.
questions.explanation: 🔍 نحتاج حال (adverb) ليصف الفعل 'ask'. 'happily' = بسعادة. 'happy' صفة، و'happiness' اسم.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT order only.
options: She has lived in American 1980 since.
She since has lived in America 1980.
She has since 1980 lived in America.
She has lived in America since 1980.
questions.explanation: 🔍 ترتيب الجملة الصحيح: فاعل + have/has + V3 + مفعول به + since + سنة. 'She has lived in America since 1980.'

questions.question: If I were you, I ______ buy that television on sale.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الشرط الثاني: if + past simple + would + V1. 'If I were you, I would buy' = لو كنت مكانك، لكنت اشتريت.

questions.question: ______ for my exam all week.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'all week' تشير إلى فترة مستمرة حتى الآن. 'have been studying' = كنت أدرس طوال الأسبوع (وما زلت). المضارع التام المستمر هو الأنسب.

questions.question: It ______ hours to do my English writing homework.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الصيغة الصحيحة: It takes me + وقت + to + V1. 'It takes me hours to do my homework.' 'takes me' مع الفاعل المفرد 'it'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: He is in his fifty years.
He is in his fifties years.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'in his fifties' = في الخمسينات من عمره. الصيغة الصحيحة: in his + عدد (جمع) للدلالة على العمر. 'fifty' مفرد و'years' غير ضرورية.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: The number of English speakers is falling sharply.
The number of English speakers are falling sharply.
The number of English speakers is sharply falling.
Sharply the number of English speakers is falling.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'The number of' + اسم جمع تأخذ فعل مفرد (is). ترتيب الظروف: فعل + حال (falling sharply) أفضل من 'sharply falling'. الخيار 0 هو الأصح.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT statement.
options: I travelled to France because to learn French.
I travelled to France so that I learn French.
I travelled to France for learn French.
I travelled to France due to learn French.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'so that' تتبعها جملة كاملة. 'so that I learn French' = لكي أتعلم الفرنسية. 'because to' و'for learn' و'due to learn' كلها خطأ.

questions.question: Have we had any emails ______?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'recently' = مؤخراً، وتستخدم مع المضارع التام في السؤال. 'ago' و'yesterday' مع الماضي البسيط، و'at this moment' مع المضارع المستمر.

questions.question: How ______ eggs do you need to make a cake?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'eggs' اسم معدود جمع، لذا نستخدم 'many'. 'much' مع غير المعدود، و'little' و'few' مع النفي.

questions.question: I'll call you as soon as I ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 في جمل الزمان المستقبلية ('as soon as') نستخدم المضارع البسيط بدلاً من المستقبل. 'as soon as I arrive' = حالما أصل. لا نستخدم 'will arrive'.

questions.question: The animal that you saw last year ______ a wolf.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'might have been' = قد يكون (في الماضي). الحدث وقع في الماضي ('last year')، لذا نستخدم 'might have been' للتعبير عن احتمالية في الماضي.

questions.question: He ______ listens to my advice.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'never' = أبداً، وتأتي قبل الفعل الرئيسي. 'He never listens' = لا يستمع أبداً. 'does not' تحتاج إلى فعل، و'ever' تستخدم في السؤال.

questions.question: ______ my socks? B. Yes, I saw them on your bed.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Have you seen' = هل رأيت؟ (مضارع تام). الجواب 'I saw them' في الماضي البسيط. السؤال عن رؤية حدثت مؤخراً، لذا نستخدم المضارع التام.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'ought to' تتبعها المصدر (V1). 'You ought to study harder' = ينبغي أن تدرس بجد. 'ought' بدون 'to' أو مع 'studies' أو 'studying' خطأ.

questions.question: He realized that he ______ his car keys in the office.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي التام (had left) يستخدم للحدث الذي حدث قبل حدث آخر في الماضي (realized). 'had left his keys' = كان قد ترك مفاتيحه. 'was leaving' مستمر، و'has left' للمضارع التام.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: I am supposed to clean the room, but I didn't.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'am supposed' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'I was supposed to clean' (في الماضي). 'am supposed' للحاضر، ولكن الجملة تتحدث عن شيء لم يحدث في الماضي.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: There is nothing I can say.
There isn't nothing I can say.
There is nothing I couldn't say.
There are nothing I can say.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'There is nothing I can say' = لا يوجد شيء يمكنني قوله. 'isn't nothing' نفي مزدوج خطأ، و'couldn't' تغير المعنى، و'are' مع 'nothing' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Smoking could be the cause of this cough your have.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'have' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'this cough you have' أو 'your cough'. 'your have' غير صحيحة نحويًا.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Although the film has some famous actors in it, but people find them boring and uninteresting.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'but' هو الخطأ. لا نستخدم 'but' مع 'Although'. الصحيح: 'Although the film has..., people find them boring.' أو 'The film has..., but people find them boring.'

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: You should read the instructions first so that you know how to use the camera.
You should read the instructions first in order to know how to use the camera.
You should read the instructions first because you know how to use the camera.
You should read the instructions first to know how to use the camera.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'because' تعني 'لأن' وتعطي سبباً، وليس غرضاً. الجملة تعني: اقرأ التعليمات لأنك تعرف كيف تستخدم الكاميرا (وهذا غير منطقي). الصحيح استخدام 'so that' أو 'to'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: The doctor told her she needed some medicine for get better.
The doctor told her she needs some medicine to get better.
The doctor told her she needed some medicine to getting better.
The doctor told her she needed some medicine to get better.
questions.explanation: 🔍 في الكلام المنقول، نرجع الزمن: 'needs' → 'needed'. 'to get better' = لكي تتحسن. الخيارات الأخرى: 'for get' خطأ، و'to getting' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Play volleyball on the beach is fun.
To play volleyball on the beach is fun.
Playing volleyball on the beach is fun.
Playing volleyball on the beach is fun.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Playing' كـ Gerund (اسم مصدر) يصلح كفاعل للجملة. 'Play' فعل لا يصلح، و'To play' (مصدر) صحيح أيضاً ولكن الخيار 3 هو الأكثر شيوعاً.

questions.question: This can ______ a malfunction in the ventilation system.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'result in' = يؤدي إلى، ينتج عنه. 'can result in a malfunction' = يمكن أن يؤدي إلى عطل. 'lead in' خطأ (الصحيح 'lead to')، و'due to' و'because' لا تصلحان مع 'can'.

questions.question: I ______ to try to climb the Himalayas.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'have always wanted' = لطالما أردت. ترتيب الظروف الصحيح: have + always + wanted. 'always' تأتي بين الفعل المساعد والفعل الرئيسي.

questions.question: Albert Einstein ______ he was four.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'couldn't talk until' = لم يستطع التحدث حتى. المعنى: أينشتاين لم يستطع التحدث حتى بلغ الرابعة. 'until' تعني 'حتى'. 'unless' = ما لم.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Sam is leaving forever his things around the room.
Forever Sam is leaving his things around the room.
Sam is leaving his things around the room forever.
Sam is forever leaving his things around the room forever.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'forever' تأتي في نهاية الجملة كظرف زمان. 'Sam is leaving his things around the room forever' صحيحة. الخيار 4 بها تكرار لـ 'forever'.

questions.question: It's advised ______ the educational places.
questions.explanation: 🔍 بعد 'it's advised' نستخدم 'to + V1'. 'to visit the educational places' = زيارة الأماكن التعليمية. 'you should visit' هي جملة كاملة وليست تكملة لـ 'it's advised'.

questions.question: Syria ______ for decades before it became independent.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي التام (had struggled) يستخدم للحدث الذي استمر قبل حدث آخر في الماضي (became independent). 'had struggled for decades' = كانت قد كافحت لعقود.

questions.question: It ______ matter of time before conventional teaching is replaced by networking alternatives.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'It is only a matter of time' = إنها مجرد مسألة وقت. 'only a' هو الترتيب الصحيح. 'only is' و'is an only' و'an only is' كلها خطأ.

questions.question: Lung disease ______ by lack of practice and smoking.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'can be caused' = يمكن أن يسببها. المجهول مع 'can': can + be + V3. الجملة تتحدث عن سبب محتمل (can). 'was able to cause' للمجهول خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that is equal in meaning to: 'You must practice for 6 hours a day.'
options: They made us practice for six hours a day.
They allowed us to practice for six hours a day.
They persuaded us to practice for six hours a day.
They didn't allow us to practice for six hours a day.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'They made us practice' = جعلونا نتدرب (إجبار). هذا يعادل 'must' (يجب) من ناحية الإجبار. 'allowed' و'persuaded' أضعف، و'didn't allow' عكس المعنى.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: The economy of the USA witnessed a drastic fall during the 1930s. Many people lost their jobs and a number of companies gone bankrupt.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'gone' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'went bankrupt' (الماضي البسيط). 'gone' هو التصريف الثالث ولا يصلح مع 'companies' كفعل ماضٍ.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: He is not interested about reading novels.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'about' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'interested in reading novels'. نستخدم 'interested in' وليس 'interested about'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Juanita had worked for that company since twelve years when they fired her.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'since' هو الخطأ. مع المدة الزمنية (twelve years) نستخدم 'for' وليس 'since'. الصحيح: 'for twelve years'.

questions.question: You must ______ home now.
questions.explanation: 🔍 بعد 'must' نستخدم المصدر (V1). 'You must go home now' = يجب أن تذهب إلى المنزل الآن. 'to go' و'going' و'to going' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Despite the exam had been too hard, everyone passed.
Although the exam had been too hard, everyone passed.
In spite of the exam had been too hard, everyone passed.
Inspite the exam had been too hard, everyone passed.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Although' تتبعها جملة كاملة. 'Although the exam had been too hard' = على الرغم من أن الامتحان كان صعباً جداً. 'Despite' و'In spite of' يتبعها اسم أو V-ing وليس جملة.

questions.question: We are looking ______ a new flat near the city center.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'look for' = يبحث عن. 'We are looking for a new flat' = نبحث عن شقة جديدة. 'look by' و'look of' و'look to' لا تستخدم بهذا المعنى.

questions.question: The book ______ be published last week.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'was meant to' = كان من المفترض أن. الحدث في الماضي ('last week') لذا نستخدم الماضي. 'is meant to' للحاضر، و'means to' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Sam has a four rooms house.
Sam has a four- room- house.
Sam has a four- room house.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الصفة المركبة: four-room house (غرفة واحدة مفردة مع واصلة). 'four-room' صفة، و'house' اسم. لا نضيف 's' للصفة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: All flights will be cancelled because the bad weather.
All flights will be cancelled although the bad weather.
All flights will be cancelled due to the bad weather.
All flights will be cancelled therefore the bad weather.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'due to' = بسبب، وتتبعها اسم. 'due to the bad weather' = بسبب الطقس السيء. 'because' تتبعها جملة، و'although' للتناقض، و'therefore' للنتيجة.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: However, it is unclear what criteria they will use to arrive to their decision.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'to' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'arrive at their decision' (يتوصلون إلى قرارهم). 'arrive to' خطأ، والصحيح 'arrive at' مع القرارات.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Do you know where the bus station is?
Do you know where is the bus station?
Do you know where is the bus station built?
Do you know where was the bus station built?
questions.explanation: 🔍 في السؤال غير المباشر، نضع الفاعل قبل الفعل: 'where the bus station is'. الخيارات الأخرى بها ترتيب خاطئ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: This shirt is still dirty even though I have washed it twice.
This shirt is still dirty even if I have washed it twice.
This shirt is still dirty whenever I have washed it twice.
This shirt is still dirty despite though I have washed it twice.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'even though' = على الرغم من، وتستخدم مع جملة كاملة. 'even if' = حتى لو، و'whenever' = كلما، و'despite though' مزيج خاطئ.

questions.question: The company made ______ less money than last year.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'much' تستخدم لتوكيد المقارنة. 'much less money' = مال أقل بكثير. 'a good deal' تستخدم مع 'more'، و'by far' مع التفضيل، و'not quite' تعني 'ليس تماماً'.

questions.question: Toshiba ______ the new laptop by the end of June.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'by the end of June' تشير إلى وقت محدد في المستقبل، والفعل سيكون مكتملاً بحلول ذلك الوقت. نستخدم المستقبل التام: 'will have launched'.

questions.question: Who ______ the advertisements for the new products?
questions.explanation: 🔍 السؤال عن الفاعل ('Who') لا يحتاج إلى 'do' أو 'did'. نستخدم 'makes' مع الفاعل المفرد في المضارع البسيط. 'Who makes the advertisements?'

questions.question: If they offered him a better salary, he ______ the job.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الشرط الثاني: if + past simple + would + V1. 'If they offered... he would accept' = إذا عرضوا عليه... لكان قبل.

questions.question: When you visit a new country, it ______ the museums and education centres.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'it is recommended to visit' = يُنصح بزيارة. 'to visit' هو المصدر المناسب. 'you visit' تحتاج إلى 'that'، و'visiting' و'visit' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: He left early to catch the train.
He left early in order to not miss the train.
He left early so as to catch the train.
He left early in order not to miss the train.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'in order to not' خطأ. الصحيح: 'in order not to miss' (لكي لا يفوت). ترتيب النفي مع 'in order to' هو: in order not to + V1.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: On my day off I am inhabited of spending all morning in bed.
On my day off I am in the habit of spending all morning in bed.
On my day off I have the habit of spending all morning in bed.
On my day off I usually spend all morning in bed.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'am inhabited of' خطأ. 'inhabited' تعني 'مأهول' أو 'يسكن'. الصحيح: 'in the habit of' = معتاد على.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: She writes in a direct humorous manner yet.
She writes in a direct yet humorous manner.
She writes in a direct manner, though humorous.
She writes in a direct manner, although humorous.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'yet' في نهاية الجملة خطأ. 'yet' تستخدم للربط بين صفتين: 'direct yet humorous' = مباشر ولكن فكاهي. الخيارات الأخرى صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: SVU tutors have the advantage of teaching from their homes.
SVU tutors have the teaching advantage from their homes.
SVU tutors have the advantage of teaches from their homes.
SVU tutors have the advantage of to teach from their homes.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'have the advantage of + V-ing' = لديهم ميزة. 'teaching' هو الصحيح. 'teaching advantage' خطأ، و'teaches' و'to teach' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Superman made their first debut in 1983 in action films.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'their' هو الخطأ. سوبرمان شخصية مفردة، لذا نستخدم 'his' وليس 'their'. 'his first debut' = أول ظهور له.

questions.question: Last year I graduated and got a great job, two events ______ totally changed my life.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'that' تستخدم للإشارة إلى حدثين سبق ذكرهما. 'those' و'these' للجمع، و'there' للمكان.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: All my friends believes there's life on Mars but I don't.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'believes' هو الخطأ. الفاعل 'All my friends' جمع، لذا نستخدم 'believe' وليس 'believes'. الصحيح: 'All my friends believe...'

questions.question: We ______ to the party on Friday.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'are going' = المضارع المستمر للخطط المستقبلية. 'on Friday' تشير إلى خطة مستقبلية. 'had gone' و'have gone' للماضي، و'go' للمضارع.

questions.question: How long ______ as a dentist before you changed jobs?
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي التام (had you worked) يستخدم للحدث الذي حدث قبل حدث آخر في الماضي (changed jobs). 'before you changed' تشير إلى التسلسل الزمني.

questions.question: An earthquake hit when the workers ______ to remove the ruins of an old house.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي المستمر (were trying) يستخدم للفعل الذي كان مستمراً عند حدوث حدث آخر (earthquake hit). 'were trying' = كانوا يحاولون.

questions.question: Riding a horse is not ______ riding a bike.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'as easy as' للمساواة مع النفي. 'not as easy as' = ليس بنفس السهولة. 'easier than' للمقارنة وليس المساواة، و'so easy than' و'more easy than' خطأ.

questions.question: The mother ran ______ her son in the park.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'ran after' = ركض وراء. الأم ركضت وراء ابنها. 'run at' و'run near' و'run for' لا تعبر عن المطاردة.

questions.question: Hardly ever ______ out in the evening.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Hardly ever' في بداية الجملة تسبب الانعكاس: 'do we go'. 'Hardly ever do we go out' = نادراً ما نخرج. 'we go' و'we will go' و'we did go' خطأ.

questions.question: My brother travelled to ______ UK to buy ______ books.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'the UK' لأنها دولة (المملكة المتحدة) مع 'the'. 'books' جمع عام بدون 'the'. لذا: 'the UK' و 'X books'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: If we didn't finish our project early, we'd stay all night working.
If we finish our project early, we could eat out.
If we do not finish our project early, we would not eat out.
If we finished our project early, we will eat out.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الشرط الأول: if + present + can/will + V1. 'If we finish early, we could eat out' = إذا أنهينا مبكراً، يمكننا أن نأكل خارجاً. الخيارات الأخرى بها أخطاء في المزج بين الأزمنة.

questions.question: Almost all my friends are good ______ solving problems.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'good at' = جيد في (مهارة). 'good at solving problems' = جيد في حل المشاكل. 'in' و'for' و'on' لا تستخدم مع 'good' بهذا المعنى.

questions.question: The plane is ______ than the train.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'faster' للمقارنة مع الصفات القصيرة. 'fast' → 'faster'. 'more faster' مزدوجة، و'more fast' خطأ لأن 'fast' صفة قصيرة.

questions.question: Don't put ______ till tomorrow what you can do today.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'put off' = يؤجل. 'Don't put off till tomorrow' = لا تؤجل إلى الغد. 'put up' = يرفع، و'put on' = يلبس، و'put in' = يضع.

questions.question: ______ of the stagnation, many workers were made redundant.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Due to' = بسبب. 'Due to the stagnation' = بسبب الركود. 'As a result' تتبعها جملة، و'Instead' = بدلاً من، و'In spite' = على الرغم من.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: She stopped to crying after three hours.
Continue walked till you reach the restaurant.
It began rains in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'started studying' = بدأ الدراسة. 'stopped crying' (بدون 'to')، و'continue walking'، و'began raining' - الخيار 0 هو الصحيح.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: You can go to the party today?
Are you can go to the party today?
Do you can go to the party today?
Can you go to the party today?
questions.explanation: 🔍 ترتيب السؤال مع 'can': Can + فاعل + V1؟ 'Can you go to the party today؟' الخيارات الأخرى بها أخطاء في الترتيب.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: I always was aware of those dangers.
I was aware always of those dangers.
I was always aware of those dangers.
I was aware of those dangers always.
questions.explanation: 🔍 ترتيب الظروف الصحيح: was + always + aware. 'I was always aware' = كنت دائماً مدركاً. 'always' تأتي بعد الفعل المساعد وقبل الصفة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Could I buy stamps?' = هل يمكنني شراء طوابع؟ (طلب مهذب). 'Can I' صحيح أيضاً ولكن 'Could' أكثر تهذيباً. 'able to' تحتاج إلى 'am'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: They are watch the match now.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'watch' هو الخطأ. مع 'are' في المضارع المستمر، نستخدم V-ing. الصحيح: 'They are watching the match now.'

questions.question: Take a taxi or you ______ miss the plane!
questions.comment: ملاحظة: الإجابة الصحيحة هي 'might' أو 'will' حسب السياق، ولكن 'might' هي الأنسب
questions.explanation: 🔍 'might miss' = قد تفوت. 'Take a taxi or you might miss the plane' = خذ تاكسي وإلا قد تفوت الطائرة. 'won't' تعني 'لن تفوت' (عكس المعنى).

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT part: Not only did she took my book, she gave it to him!
questions.explanation: 🔍 'not only...but also' = ليس فقط...بل أيضاً. 'Not only did she take my book, but she also gave it to him!' 'also' هو الجزء المطلوب.

questions.question: The first thing I'll do is to drive to my uncle's house if ______.
options: I had gotten my driving license
I would get my driving license
questions.explanation: 🔍 الشرط الأول: if + present + will. 'if I get my driving license' = إذا حصلت على رخصة القيادة. 'I'll do' في المستقبل، لذا نستخدم المضارع في الشرط.

questions.question: Right now I ______ my English exam.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Right now' تشير إلى الحدث الجاري الآن، لذا نستخدم المضارع المستمر: 'am doing'. 'did' للماضي، و'do' للمضارع البسيط، و'had done' للماضي التام.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: My friend got married in December 3 and got divorced after four months. She now had a baby boy and plans look after him.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'go married' خطأ. الصحيح: 'got married' (تزوج). 'got' هو الماضي الصحيح لـ 'get'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: Take a sandwich because of you get hungry.
Take a sandwich although you get hungry.
Take a sandwich in case you get hungry.
Take a sandwich even though you get hungry.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'in case' = تحسباً، لئلا. 'Take a sandwich in case you get hungry' = خذ ساندويتش تحسباً للجوع. 'because of' و'although' و'even though' لا تناسب.

questions.question: The teacher gave a lesson ______ she was very tired.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'even though' = على الرغم من. 'The teacher gave a lesson even though she was tired' = أعطت المعلمة درساً على الرغم من أنها كانت متعبة.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: I have the most expensivest house in town.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'expensivest' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'most expensive' (للصفات الطويلة). 'expensivest' غير صحيحة لأن 'expensive' طويلة.

questions.question: You ______ have a driver's license before you buy a car.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'have to' = يجب (إجبار خارجي). 'You have to have a driver's license' = يجب أن يكون لديك رخصة قيادة. 'need' تحتاج إلى 'to'، و'must to' خطأ.

questions.question: Please ______ soon.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'make up your mind' = قرر (خذ قرارك). هذه عبارة اصطلاحية. 'make up your mind soon' = قرر بسرعة. الخيارات الأخرى بها أخطاء في الترتيب.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
options: What is the cost of repairing this car?
What is the price of this TV?
How much did cleaning your garage price?
How much did this t-shirt cost?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'How much did cleaning your garage price?' خطأ. الصحيح: 'How much did it cost to clean your garage؟' أو 'How much did cleaning your garage cost؟'

questions.question: The police ______ after the suspect for two hours when they discovered he was an Olympic athlete.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي التام المستمر (had been running) للحدث المستمر قبل حدث آخر في الماضي (discovered). 'had been running for two hours' = كانوا يركضون لمدة ساعتين.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Are these hers books?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'hers' هو الخطأ. 'hers' ضمير ملكية (بدون اسم بعده). الصحيح: 'her books' (صفة ملكية + اسم).

questions.question: The flight ______ due to the bad weather.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي البسيط في المجهول: was + V3. 'The flight was cancelled' = تم إلغاء الرحلة. 'cancelled' (بدون 'was') خطأ، و'was cancelling' للمستمر.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: If anyone has a question tell him to come see me in the office.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'him' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'tell them' (لأن 'anyone' محايد وغير محدد). 'tell them to come' = أخبرهم أن يأتوا.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Don't disturbing her, she's trying to finish her new book.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'disturbing' هو الخطأ. بعد 'Don't' نستخدم المصدر (V1). الصحيح: 'Don't disturb her'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: Yesterday we've been to the cinema and then had a drink.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'we've been' هو الخطأ. مع 'Yesterday' (وقت محدد في الماضي) نستخدم الماضي البسيط. الصحيح: 'we went to the cinema'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: When he arrived the film started so he missed the first ten minutes.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'arrived' هو الخطأ. المعنى: عندما وصل بدأ الفيلم (أي بدأ قبل وصوله). الصحيح: 'When he arrived, the film had started' (ماضي تام).

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: I was listening to radio when they had arrived.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'had arrived' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'arrived' (ماضي بسيط) مع 'when' لأن الفعلين وقعا في نفس الوقت تقريباً.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: The train leaves at 8.30 so make sure you're don't late.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'don't' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'you're not late' (لست متأخراً) أو 'you aren't late'. 'don't late' خطأ.

questions.question: She went ______ home.
questions.explanation: 🔍 لا نستخدم حرف جر مع 'home' عندما يأتي بعد فعل الحركة. 'She went home' = ذهبت إلى المنزل. 'to home' خطأ.

questions.question: I work ______ Seattle.
questions.explanation: 🔍 نستخدم 'in' مع المدن. 'I work in Seattle' = أعمل في سياتل. 'onto' و'about' وبدون حرف جر خطأ.

questions.question: He went ______ his friend's house.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'to' تستخدم مع الاتجاهات. 'He went to his friend's house' = ذهب إلى منزل صديقه. 'about' و'with' و'over' لا تعبر عن الاتجاه.

questions.question: I ______ TV when the telephone rang.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي المستمر (was watching) للفعل المستمر عند حدوث فعل آخر (rang). 'was watching' مع الفاعل المفرد 'I'.

questions.question: I'm afraid I'm not hungry. I've ______ eaten lunch.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'already' = بالفعل، وتستخدم في المثبت مع المضارع التام. 'I've already eaten lunch' = لقد تناولت الغداء بالفعل. 'yet' في النفي، و'still' = ما زال.

questions.question: My mother let me ______ late when I was a child.
questions.explanation: 🔍 بعد 'let' نستخدم المصدر المجرد (V1). 'let me stay' = سمحت لي بالبقاء. 'to stay' و'staying' و'to staying' خطأ.

questions.question: Would you like ______ chicken?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'some' في العرض (offer) وليس في السؤال العادي. 'Would you like some chicken؟' = هل تريد بعض الدجاج؟ 'any' تستخدم في الأسئلة العادية.

questions.question: He has ______ friends in Chicago.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'a few' = بعض (مع الجمع المعدود). 'a few friends' = بعض الأصدقاء. 'much' مع غير المعدود، و'lots' تحتاج إلى 'of'، و'a lot' تحتاج إلى 'of'.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT sentence.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'them selves' خطأ. الصحيح: 'themselves' (ضمير منعكس). 'themselves' تُكتب ككلمة واحدة وليس كلمتين.

questions.question: She ______ lunch by the time we arrived.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي التام (had finished) للحدث الذي حدث قبل حدث آخر في الماضي (arrived). 'had finished lunch' = كانت قد انتهت من الغداء.

questions.question: If I were you I ______ that television on sale.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الشرط الثاني: if + past simple + would + V1. 'If I were you, I would buy' = لو كنت مكانك، لكنت اشتريت.

questions.question: ______ you ever ______ to England?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Have you ever been to England؟' = هل سبق أن ذهبت إلى إنجلترا؟ 'ever' مع المضارع التام، و'been' = ذهبت وعُدت. 'gone' = ذهب ولم يعد.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT order only.
options: In China the rice is growing.
questions.explanation: 🔍 المجهول في المضارع البسيط: is + V3. 'Rice is grown in China' = يُزرع الأرز في الصين. 'growing' و'grew' و'grow' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT statement.
options: If he's feeling ill, he should to see the doctor.
If he's feeling ill, he should see the doctor.
If he's feeling ill, he should seeing the doctor.
If he's feeling ill, he should sees the doctor.
questions.explanation: 🔍 بعد 'should' نستخدم المصدر (V1). 'He should see the doctor' = ينبغي أن يرى الطبيب. 'should to' و'should seeing' و'should sees' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT order. You can see the coast from the window.
options: You can see the coast from the window.
You can to see the coast from the window.
You can seeing the coast from the window.
You can to seeing the coast from the window.
questions.explanation: 🔍 بعد 'can' نستخدم المصدر (V1). 'You can see' = يمكنك رؤية. 'to see' و'seeing' و'to seeing' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: By next week I would have finished my study.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'would' هو الخطأ. مع 'By next week' نستخدم المستقبل التام: 'will have finished' وليس 'would have finished'. 'would' للماضي.

questions.question: When I go to the office, I realized I ______ my keys at home.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي التام (had left) للحدث الذي حدث قبل حدث آخر في الماضي (realized). 'had left my keys' = كنت قد تركت مفاتيحي.

questions.question: You ______ to register in this course.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'don't need to' = لا تحتاج إلى. 'You don't need to register' = لا تحتاج إلى التسجيل. 'shouldn't' = لا ينبغي، و'mustn't' = ممنوع.

questions.question: Last time I ______ to France, I was 10 years old.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي البسيط (went) مع 'last time' (وقت محدد في الماضي). 'went to France' = ذهبت إلى فرنسا. 'been' و'gone' و'have gone' خطأ.

questions.question: We ______ to Sally's party last week.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي البسيط في المجهول: were + V3. 'We were invited' = تمت دعوتنا. 'are invited' للحاضر، و'invited' بدون 'were' خطأ.

questions.question: - I will buy some bread tomorrow. - She said she ______ some bread the next day.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الكلام المنقول: 'will' → 'would'. 'She said she would buy' = قالت إنها ستشتري. 'would buy' هو الصحيح.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: She feels so exciting when she passes her exam.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'exciting' هو الخطأ. الصحيح: 'excited' (لوصف شعور الشخص). 'exciting' تصف الشيء المسبب للشعور.

questions.question: Nutrition experts advise us ______ too many refined foods.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'advise + object + not to + V1'. 'advise us not to eat' = ينصحوننا بعدم أكل. 'to don't eat' خطأ، و'eating' و'to eat' تعنيان العكس.

questions.question: She had to give ______ her job when her son was born.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'give up' = يتخلى عن، يترك. 'give up her job' = تترك وظيفتها. 'give in' = يستسلم، و'give off' = ينبعث، و'give away' = يتبرع.

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT part: The number of English learners are increasing.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'are' هو الخطأ. 'The number of' تأخذ فعل مفرد (is). الصحيح: 'The number of English learners is increasing.'

questions.question: When you visit a new country, it ______ the museums and education centres.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'it is advised that you visit' = يُنصح بأن تزور. 'that + clause' هو الصحيح. 'you visit' (بدون 'that') خطأ، و'visiting' و'visit' خطأ.

questions.question: ______ you get off a plane in a foreign country, you should go through Customs.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'When' = عندما. 'When you get off a plane' = عندما تنزل من الطائرة. 'Where' للمكان، و'Whose' للملكية، و'Who' للفاعل.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: My sister and I are different, and we get on well together.
My sister and I are different, so we get on well together.
My sister and I are different, but we get on well together.
My sister and I are different, because we get on well together.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'but' للربط بين جملتين متضادتين. 'different' و'get on well' متناقضان، لذا نستخدم 'but'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: It is only a matter of time and everything was discovered.
It is only a matter of time before everything is discovered.
It is only a matter of time that everything is discovered.
It is only a matter of time that everything was discovered.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'It is only a matter of time before...' = إنها مجرد مسألة وقت قبل أن... 'before everything is discovered' = قبل أن يُكتشف كل شيء. 'that' و'and' و'was' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: If he is feeling sick, he must go to the doctor.
If he is feeling sick, he musts go to the doctor.
If he is feeling sick, he must to go to the doctor.
If he is feeling sick, he must going to the doctor.
questions.explanation: 🔍 بعد 'must' نستخدم المصدر (V1). 'must go' = يجب أن يذهب. 'musts' و'must to' و'must going' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT sentence.
options: He is leaving forever the lights on in the kitchen.
He is leaving the lights on in the kitchen forever.
He forever is leaving the lights on in the kitchen.
He is forever leaving the lights on in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'is forever leaving' = المضارع المستمر مع 'forever' للتعبير عن عادة مزعجة. 'He is forever leaving the lights on' = يترك الأضواء دائماً (ويضايق).

questions.question: Choose the INCORRECT answer. - How often do you go to the cinema?
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Yes, I do' هو الجواب الخطأ. السؤال 'How often' يسأل عن التكرار، والإجابة يجب أن تكون عن التكرار (ثلاث مرات، كل يوم، أبداً). 'Yes, I do' جواب على سؤال 'Do you...؟'

questions.question: Neither one of my two brothers ______ meat.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Neither one' مفرد، لذا نستخدم 'eats'. 'Neither one of my brothers eats meat' = لا أحد من أخيَّ يأكل اللحم. 'have eaten' و'eating' و'eat' (جمع) خطأ.

questions.question: Generally speaking, nobody ______ to carry around a huge cell phone.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'nobody' مفرد، لذا نستخدم 'wants' في المضارع البسيط. 'nobody wants' = لا أحد يريد. 'want' (جمع) و'is wanting' و'wanting' خطأ.
